title: Shah Mosque, Mashhad
scope: The standing Timurid Shah Mosque and original tomb mass in Mashhad, also called Masjid-i Imam or Haftad-o Do Tan, with twin minarets, north iwan and bulbous tiled dome.
limitations: The model depicts the standing Timurid massing after later conservation. The historical photograph informs the architecture of the surviving entrance block and the damaged minaret shafts, and the published measurements control heights.
Finishes, the exact geometric tile pattern, window lattices, rear parapets and secondary vault heights are approximations. The bathhouse, buried tomb and later shrine complex are outside the model.
